title: coronilla repanda
intro: Coronilla repanda, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Coronilla repanda include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm respiratory problems, and reduce skin irritation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions are flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified to contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
